doc.brief: The QAbstractButton class is the abstract base class of button widgets, providing functionality common to buttons.
doc.index_brief: The abstract base class of button widgets, providing functionality common to buttons

QAbstractButton(QWidget *parent).brief: Constructs an abstract button with a *parent*.

QButtonGroup * group() const.brief: Returns the group that this button belongs to.

QIcon icon() const.brief: This property holds the icon shown on the button

QKeySequence shortcut() const.brief: This property holds the mnemonic associated with the button

QSize iconSize() const.brief: This property holds the icon size used for this button.

QString text() const.brief: This property holds the text shown on the button

bool autoExclusive() const.brief: This property holds whether auto-exclusivity is enabled

bool autoRepeat() const.brief: This property holds whether autoRepeat is enabled

bool hitButton(const QPoint &pos) const.brief: Returns `true` if *pos* is inside the clickable button rectangle; otherwise returns `false`.

bool isCheckable() const.brief: This property holds whether the button is checkable

bool isChecked() const.brief: This property holds whether the button is checked

bool isDown() const.brief: This property holds whether the button is pressed down

int autoRepeatDelay() const.brief: This property holds the initial delay of auto-repetition

int autoRepeatInterval() const.brief: This property holds the interval of auto-repetition

void animateClick().brief: Performs an animated click: the button is pressed immediately, and released 100ms later.

void checkStateSet().brief: This virtual handler is called when [setChecked](xref:qt:QAbstractButton)() is used, unless it is called from within [nextCheckState](xref:qt:QAbstractButton)().

void clicked(bool checked).brief: This signal is emitted when the button is activated (i.e., pressed down then released while the mouse cursor is inside the button), when the shortcut key is typed, or when...

void nextCheckState().brief: This virtual handler is called when a button is clicked.

void pressed().brief: This signal is emitted when the button is pressed down.

void released().brief: This signal is emitted when the button is released.

void setAutoExclusive(bool).brief: This property holds whether auto-exclusivity is enabled

void setAutoRepeat(bool).brief: This property holds whether autoRepeat is enabled

void setAutoRepeatInterval(int).brief: This property holds the interval of auto-repetition

void setCheckable(bool).brief: This property holds whether the button is checkable

void setChecked(bool).brief: This property holds whether the button is checked

void setDown(bool).brief: This property holds whether the button is pressed down

void setIconSize(const QSize &size).brief: This property holds the icon size used for this button.

void setShortcut(const QKeySequence &key.brief: This property holds the mnemonic associated with the button

void setText(const QString &text).brief: This property holds the text shown on the button

void toggle().brief: Toggles the state of a checkable button.

void toggled(bool checked).brief: This signal is emitted whenever a checkable button changes its state. *checked* is true if the button is checked, or false if the button is unchecked.
